brief: Disclosures for Sorrento Therapeutics, Inc. trial NCT04903327 (COVI-MSC, phase 2, terminated; primary completion 2022-08-29, completion 2022-11-23). Find what Sorrento told investors in 8-Ks about this trial or COVI-MSC near when it stopped. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: No 8-K filing specifically mentions trial NCT04903327 near when it stopped; 8-Ks mentioning the drug COVI-MSC (such as exhibit 99.1/99.2 filings in early 2023) only mention COVI-MSC as a trademark or candidate under development and give no reason regarding the trial's termination.
findings.notes: Searched SEC filings for Sorrento Therapeutics (CIK 0000850261) for NCT04903327 and COVI-MSC around the trial's termination window in late 2022 and early 2023. Mentions of COVI-MSC in 8-K exhibits are standard trademark/pipeline mentions and give no reason.
